mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE media_asset SET state = 'ACTIVE' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE media_asset SET state = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE media_asset SET state = 'DELETING' WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE media_asset SET state = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'DELETING'
mapper.select: SELECT path FROM media_asset WHERE state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DELETING')
SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{graceSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE state = 'DELETING' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{graceSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM media_asset WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DELETING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND state IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','DELETING')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation_media WHERE media_id = #{mediaId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task_media WHERE media_id = #{mediaId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_result WHERE media_id = #{mediaId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation_media cm JOIN creation c ON c.id = cm.creation_id WHERE cm.media_id = #{mediaId} AND c.state = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset WHERE state = #{state}
